title: AI采购反转：价格不是第一，质量定胜负
speaker: Mary Ann Sung

segments.en: If I'm a large enterprise that's deploying AI solutions, it's not only about the price.
segments.zh: 如果我是部署AI解决方案的大型企业，价格不是唯一考量。

segments.en: The quality of AI solutions is also equally important.
segments.zh: AI解决方案的质量同样重要。

segments.en: So when we look at this equation, we look at both cost, structural, but also the quality of the token output and also token services.
segments.zh: 因此，我们既看成本结构，也看Token输出和服务的质量。

segments.en: I think this is where we are significantly well positioned for it.
segments.zh: 我认为这正是我们的优势所在。
